title: Walmart Shoplifting Couple Goes Nuts When Caught
description:
On April 14th, 2023, an officer responded to a retail theft. Dispatch advised that store employees had caught a male and a female shoplifting multiple cosmetics items and keeping them in one of their personal bags, as seen on their CCTV cameras. Upon arriving at the scene, the officer located the suspects and prevented them from leaving the area. The couple continued to behave erratically even after being cuffed. Shortly after, one of the officers found a gun in the couple’s truck. Soon, one of the officers took away the female and Mirandized her. The male began complaining about his cuffs being too tight and that he was in severe pain. Meanwhile, the medics arrived to check up on the male’s injury. The officers brought the suspect’s dog to the female. The officer tried explaining the situation to the female. The male was charged with resisting arrest, retail theft and aggravated assault on a peace officer while the female was charged with resisting arrest and was released with a ban sheet.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
